description: This file defines the 'OmiProxy' class which implements the 'IOmiProxy' interface for managing OMI proxy operations, including mounting crypted bundles, registering listeners, and managing IPC service connections. It also provides static methods for setting implementations and constructors for object creation.

classes.name: OmiProxy
classes.description: Implementation of the IOmiProxy interface enabling OMI proxy functionalities such as crypted bundle management and listener registration.

methods.name: setImpl
methods.description: Sets the static implementation of the IOmiProxy interface.

methods.name: OmiProxy(const std::shared_ptr<AI_IPC::IIpcService>&, const std::string&, const std::string&)
methods.description: Parameterized constructor initializing the proxy with an IPC service, service name, and object name.

methods.name: mountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Mounts a crypted bundle given its id, root filesystem path, config JSON path, and outputs the bundle directory path.

methods.name: umountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Unmounts a crypted bundle identified by its id.

methods.name: registerListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for OMI events, returning a tag for future deregistration.

methods.name: unregisterListener
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered listener using its tag.
